entries.trigger: Home has no currently valid chart data, or quote recovery has failed or returned incomplete data.
entries.presentation: quiet chart shimmer while missing current data; no offline label, retry text or tap target
entries.recommendation: Show shimmer while current chart data is unavailable and continue automatic background recovery. Do not show offline text or a retry control.
entries.assessment: Removed the offline/retry text, tap target and retry-action semantics. When no valid chart exists, the existing animated candle shimmer remains while idempotent market reads continue quietly. Missing/expired price and change values use their existing shimmer. A currently valid same-currency chart survives complete refresh failure and now also partial-history failure, only until its original expiry; fresh spot data cannot extend an older chart deadline. Existing backoff continues at 5, 10, 20, 40 and 60 seconds base with 20% jitter and longer Retry-After respected. Retries continue while observed, without a tight loop; disposing the provider cancels requests and timers. No stale quote is presented as current.
entries.verification: October 26 production PriceCard source and 60 Home/market host tests passed. Coverage includes offline then repeated failure then automatic recovery without tapping, all failure categories, partial-history retention with original freshness/currency checks, and no requests after provider disposal including active HTTP drainage. Scoped Dart analysis passed. Log: .buildlog/quiet-home-chart-20261026-tests.log. The market provider retry policy was already present; no native stack/network fault was injected for this documentation update.

confirmation.behavior: Cancel/dismissal leaves wallet data unchanged. Confirm requests fresh wallet-bound device authentication when a device credential exists; no credential follows the approved no-auth policy. Deletion proceeds only after active-wallet identity, payment/preparation fences and native RGB audit pass.
confirmation.paragraphLayout: Single continuous paragraph, including destination sentence.
confirmation.contentActionsGapProof: The same shared 40 logical-pixel layout gap as App lock. 18 geometry tests cover both copies, original paragraph break, 1×/3× text, button-only and inherited caller Theme overrides.
confirmation.authenticationOrdering: Keep prompt ownership until foreground both before and after the final device-security status reply. Ordinary prompt completion can arrive before Flutter lifecycle events; actual background and wallet/request changes still revoke the grant.

walletDeletionUpdate.storage: Exact deleting profile is committed before destructive cleanup. Cleanup resumes only that recorded authority after restart.
walletDeletionUpdate.presence: Only an empty committed registry clears wallet presence and returns to Welcome. With survivors, opens the first remaining ready profile.
walletDeletionUpdate.protectedState: Unresolved payment/preparation evidence, nonzero RGB balances, nonterminal RGB transfers, or an unavailable audit block deletion. BTC holdings are not the RGB guard.
walletDeletionUpdate.authentication: Fresh purpose/wallet/session-bound system authorization, except the approved no-device-credential policy. Cancellation before staging changes nothing.
walletDeletionUpdate.runtimeQualification: Separate evidence covers actual existing-wallet safety refusal and successful full SDK/native/platform-storage deletion of two disposable empty wallets with real OS authentication. The earlier memory fixtures and the native directory probe retain their original narrower scopes. This does not qualify funded-wallet deletion, physical devices or mainnet release.
walletDeletionUpdate.nativeCloseBoundary: Native SDK close is uncancellable and must drain before file removal. If it never settles, process restart is the recovery boundary; elapsed time does not release ownership for concurrent cleanup. Not all native calls are bounded.

dialogAndAuthenticationRefinement.current: Primary blue Delete confirmation; single-paragraph copy; unchanged shared 40-pixel action gap.
dialogAndAuthenticationRefinement.mechanism: A late inactive event during the final device-status RPC could silently invalidate a successful auth completion. Await foreground after that final status reply while retaining request revocation.
dialogAndAuthenticationRefinement.geometry: 18 tests measure the same 40 logical-pixel body/actions gap across both dialog copies and caller Theme variations. No distinct production gap defect reproduced.
dialogAndAuthenticationRefinement.nativeCurrentEvidence: Actual native iPhone 18 Pro Max / iOS 27 Device Hub rendering with the real OS Face ID prompt and simulated successful Face ID match. Uses production AppLoader, AsterApp, router, security controller, repository, view model and runtime with public in-memory fixture wallets and FakeEngine, in separate bundle com.example.asterdev.walletdelete.nativeauth20261026. Visible TEST DATA banner. Zero native SDK/network execution. No real user wallet was deleted.
dialogAndAuthenticationRefinement.preFixEvidence: A deliberately failing full-app ordering regression establishes the bug. An ordinary pre-fix native run passed and is not shown as a failure.

actualNativeAuditAndFeedbackUpdate.responsibility: Aster; SDK unchanged and correctly rejects invalid unscoped requests
actualNativeAuditAndFeedbackUpdate.scope: Actual existing Primary wallet on Device Hub iPhone 18 Pro Max / iOS 27. A diagnostic safe preflight executed the real native RGB audit and stopped before destructive deletion. The result protectedRgbState=true preserves the wallet; no user wallet was deleted. The real native-state read found zero imported assets and one incoming unassigned, unexpired WaitingCounterparty request. This is a legitimate pending-request safety refusal, not a fixture audit=true result or successful native deletion.
actualNativeAuditAndFeedbackUpdate.independentReview: No blockers found in the reviewed audit/feedback fixes
actualNativeAuditAndFeedbackUpdate.normalStartupAndDetailsVerification: Verified live in the restored normal app: unlock/startup → Settings → Wallet details shows Primary and Delete wallet; user wallet not deleted.
actualNativeAuditAndFeedbackUpdate.historicalEvidenceBoundary: Earlier in-memory fixture deletion successes did not execute this native audit and did not prove that a real native wallet could pass it. The earlier auth race fix remains valid but did not solve these separate causes.

realNativeDisposableQualification.scope: Real Flutter SDK/native wallet engine, platform storage and real OS Face ID prompt with a successful Simulator match, on Device Hub iPhone 18 Pro Max / iOS 27. Two fresh disposable empty QA wallets were created in a separate app bundle com.example.asterdev.deletionreal20261026.debug with its own keychain service and app-native ports 19781/19782, using the existing isolated qualification services. Real providers are used except QA configuration and keychain isolation. Seed words were never rendered, logged or captured. No normal user wallet was deleted and no containers were created or reset.
realNativeDisposableQualification.afterFirstDelete: Native QA Two removed; Native QA One remains ready and opens Home. Its own native directory remains, while the deleted directory is absent.
realNativeDisposableQualification.afterLastDelete: Native QA One removed; canonical registry empty at generation 7, native-wallet root empty, both disposable directories absent; Welcome visible.
realNativeDisposableQualification.restartPersistence: Verified: after process restart the empty QA registry still opens Welcome, with Create Wallet and Import Wallet.
realNativeDisposableQualification.normalReturnAndQaRemoval: Verified: QA bundle uninstalled; normal app foreground at Wallet details, no dialog open. Primary and Secondary ready profiles and their native directories remain. Both registry slots byte-identical to before QA; 22 normal-wallet files remain.
realNativeDisposableQualification.nativeFinancialBalanceCoverage: Empty disposable wallets only; this is not funded RGB/Bitcoin deletion or physical-device qualification.

verification.homeNotes: Removed the offline/retry text, tap target and retry-action semantics. A currently valid same-currency chart survives complete refresh failure and now also partial-history failure, only until its original expiry; fresh spot data cannot extend an older chart deadline. Existing backoff continues at 5, 10, 20, 40 and 60 seconds base with 20% jitter and longer Retry-After respected. Retries continue while observed, without a tight loop; disposing the provider cancels requests and timers. No stale quote is presented as current.

stableActionsUpdate.normalOnboardingFlow: The latest instruction removes normal onboarding loading interstitials. Welcome retains the tapped journey and its visible button loading while dictionary preflight, system authentication and the selected Create/Import provider finish. Only then does it show the intended ready recovery-phrase or import form. The prepared provider is retained across attachment. Quiz and initial naming reuse that same ready provider. The naming form keeps Continue loading through Home. Returning Back discards preparation only after the outgoing step unmounts, preventing a second mnemonic generation from a still-watched provider. Quiet defensive fallback renderers remain for unexpected direct/unrouted states; they are not the normal user journey.

Delayed dictionary/Create preparation remains on Welcome with its primary button loading; the ready provider is retained into the intended destination; quiz/naming reuse ready state; Back discards only after the outgoing owner unmounts; setup completion remains in Continue through Home. Log: .buildlog/onboarding-ready-navigation-20261026.log. Full Flutter analysis clean; normal lib/main.dart iOS Simulator build succeeded. Device Hub iPhone 18 Pro Max reached Home after native Face ID; existing wallet files preserved. Delayed-state proof is deterministic widget testing, not a newly captured native fault state.
